name: Mahou Kishi R**earth - Yami ni Ochita Hikari
original_name: 魔法騎士レイ○ース 闇に堕ちた光
source:
Hikaru, Umi and Fuu (3 heroines) have been summoned by Cephiro to a parallel world, to journey to the Spring of Alterna.

On the way to the Spring, they strayed into the Silent Forest. Lost and vulnerable, the girls are tricked by Zagato's minion, and play directly into his devious hands!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ070485.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
